records.title: Sunset Reflections from Beer Can Island
records.description:
Some sunsets remind us that endings are not always the end.

The sky lets go of one day so another can begin. It never rushes the process, never questions whether the sun will rise again. It simply trusts the rhythm.

Life has seasons like that too. Sometimes we outgrow relationships, careers, beliefs, or old versions of ourselves. It can feel uncertain while we’re in the middle of the transition, but every ending creates space for something new.

Watching the sunset at Beer Can Island was a reminder that there is beauty in letting go, even when we cannot yet see what comes next.

If you’re moving through a season of change, know that you don’t have to have all the answers today. Keep taking one step at a time. Your next sunrise is already on its way.

✨ If Human Design, astrology, and spiritual growth are part of your journey, you’re always welcome at Health Manifested. Together we explore the cycles of life and learn how to work with them instead of against them.

records.title: The Dream I Carried Home
records.description:
This song was inspired by the day I mailed my application for Irish citizenship, a dream I have carried since I was fifteen years old.

It happened under a New Moon in Cancer conjunct Mercury retrograde in my twelfth house. Cancer is connected with family, ancestry, roots, belonging, and the past. Mercury rules messages, documents, paperwork, travel, and communication. With Mercury retrograde, an old dream returned through family records, important conversations, and documents connected to my father and grandparents.

My dad is also a Cancer, which made the timing feel even more meaningful. I needed his long-form birth certificate and a certified copy of his driver’s license to complete the application. After receiving the final documents, I texted him:

“Thank you. You made a dream possible that I never knew was possible.”

The twelfth house can hold dreams that live quietly within us for many years. When I was fifteen, my dad took me to Ireland, where we met members of our family. I remember leaving Ireland and telling him that I dreamed of living there. At the time, neither of us realized Irish citizenship could one day be possible for me.

There is another powerful layer to this story. When I was fifteen and traveled to Ireland for the first time, Saturn was also in Aries in my ninth house, where my natal Sun is placed. The ninth house is connected with international travel, foreign countries, immigration, citizenship, law, and expanding beyond the world we already know.

Now Saturn has returned to Aries, and the dream that began during that earlier Saturn cycle has come back in a more official and tangible form. What began as a teenage wish is now becoming an application, a legal process, and the possibility of a new citizenship.

Saturn can represent laws, responsibility, official recognition, and commitments that take time. Aries brings the courage to begin. This feels like returning to an old dream with the maturity and determination to finally act on it.

This song is about family roots, gratitude, the return of a lifelong dream, meaningful paperwork, and the moment something that once felt impossible finally begins moving forward.

records.title: Barbara was the Family
records.description:
This song was created during Mercury retrograde in Cancer, and for me, it brought up so many memories around family, home, grief, love, and the people who make a place feel safe.

I am staying near where my step-grandmother Barbara lived, and being here has brought back so many memories of my childhood, my family, Anna Maria, Bradenton, holidays, beach days, and the life I once thought I was going to have. I wanted to move here for years because this place always felt like home. But the truth is, Barbara was the reason it felt that way.

She was the one who held the family together. She was the one who always wanted me at Thanksgiving. She would sit next to me, make me feel included, and help me feel like I belonged. I loved her so much, and I still miss her deeply.

The other day, I sat at her grave and talked to her. Cancer energy is connected to family, memories, roots, and emotional bonds. For me, Cancer is also connected to my 12th house, which can bring up endings, grief, loss, spirit, dreams, and the unseen world. When Barbara died, it felt like my family went with her. My health, my family connection, and my marriage all began to fall apart after her passing.

At the time, I was still very Christian. I did not talk to mediums, and I did not really believe in the other side. But when Barbara was passing, her caregiver said she was seeing and talking with her son and her husband who had already passed. That was the moment something opened in me.

Later, Cassadaga helped me cope with her death. It helped me feel that love does not end just because someone leaves this world.

This song is for Barbara, for Mercury retrograde in Cancer, for everyone grieving someone who felt like home, and for anyone remembering the person who made family feel like family.

Barbara was the family.
Barbara was home.
And I still feel her with me.

This is astrology in real life.

During Mercury retrograde in Cancer in the 12th house, the energy is bringing up family, ancestry, memories, emotions, documents, delays, and miscommunication. This Mercury retrograde revealed the one detail that was missed for my application.

This song is. a hope of a way to communicate to my father.

I am so close to Ireland, but this one missing document makes me feel so close and so far away at the same time.

records.title: The Girl Who Read the Stars
records.description:
This song came from a very real moment in my life.

I told my aunt that I had heard an astrologer talk about placements that show up in billionaire charts, and that I had 9 of them. I was not saying I knew I would become a billionaire. I was just feeling excited, hopeful, and reminded that maybe the dream I have been working toward could still become something real.

Her response hurt me deeply. She asked how I would feel 30 years from now if I looked back and realized I did all of this for nothing, and that I was never going to become a billionaire.

That question stayed with me. But instead of only looking 30 years into the future, I found myself looking 30 years into the past.

The last time Saturn was in Aries, I was 15 years old. That was the age when I first fell in love with astrology. I used to ride my bike to Books-A-Million and sit there reading astrology books because I loved them so much. I would look up relationship charts, compatibility, and signs, trying to understand love, destiny, and why certain people felt so meaningful.

I started wondering where I would be today if I had stayed with astrology back then instead of trying to do what other people thought I should do. I wondered what my life would have looked like if I had trusted that love for astrology sooner.

And then I realized the bigger question is not only, “What if this never works?”

The bigger question is, “Where will I be 30 years from now if I keep going?”

With Mercury in my 10th house, Chiron conjunct my Midheaven, Venus and Moon in Pisces, and a heart that has always dreamed through the stars, astrology has never really left me. It has been with me since I was 15. It was there when I dreamed of love. It was there when I dreamed of a beautiful future. It is still here now as I build, create, heal, and try to believe in myself again.

This song is for anyone who has ever been made to feel foolish for dreaming.

It is for the people who wonder if they are too late.

It is for the people who look back and wish they had trusted themselves sooner.

And it is for anyone who is choosing to keep going, not because success is guaranteed, but because the dream still lives inside them.

Watch ad free and support my work here:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtR35KzSzBakHJNre9oelHw/join

records.title: I See My Channel Rising
records.description:
This song was inspired by my own YouTube journey and the astrology behind believing in what you are creating before the results fully arrive.

I started my YouTube channel in October 2018, when Saturn was in Sagittarius in my 5th house. The 5th house is connected with creativity, self-expression, joy, and the courage to share what you create. Sagittarius is connected with belief, wisdom, teaching, publishing, and seeing a bigger vision for your life.

At that time, Saturn was also trining my Sun and trining my Leo rising. Leo is the sign of creativity, courage, visibility, self-expression, and often fame. Looking back, it feels meaningful that the planet of work, dedication, patience, and long-term building was supporting both my light and my identity when I began my channel.

Now Saturn is in Aries in my 9th house, bringing the lesson to a deeper level. The 9th house is connected with publishing, teaching, higher wisdom, faith, and sharing your message with a larger audience. Aries is where my Sun is, which connects to my courage, identity, creative fire, and the way I shine.

This song is about choosing to believe in yourself before the proof shows up. It is about showing up for your channel, your message, your creativity, and your dream even when the views are quiet, the growth is slow, or the outside world has not caught up yet.

Saturn teaches us that success is built through commitment. The 5th house reminds us to create. The 9th house reminds us to believe. Leo reminds us to shine with courage. Aries reminds us to begin. Sagittarius reminds us to trust the vision.

This is a manifestation song for YouTubers, creators, spiritual teachers, artists, and anyone building something from the heart.

You do not have to wait to be chosen.

You can choose yourself today.

records.description:

This center is not meant to be in constant motion all the time. It works best when a person learns to trust their timing, honor their energy cycles, and release the need to rush.

records.title: For better, for worse
records.description:
Today’s New Moon in Taurus brought up a memory of love, marriage, career, money, and the dreams that once felt so real.

This song was created from a very personal reflection about watching another couple begin their life together while remembering the beginning of my own marriage. The New Moon in Taurus connected with my ex-husband’s Venus and my Mercury, bringing old memories to the surface around love, vows, stability, commitment, career, and the life we once imagined we would build together.

One of the significant patterns I could see is that my ex-husband did not propose to me until after I graduated college and got my first career job. I had just earned my degree and stepped into what felt like my dream job as a network admin, managing 500 computers and 7 servers. We thought we were on top of the world. We traveled, celebrated, got married, and believed we were building a beautiful future.

Now I find myself pet sitting for a couple who is moving through a similar life moment. She just graduated college, has her first job lined up, and they are flying to Italy to get married. Watching their beginning brought me back to my own beginning.

Astrologically, this feels deeply connected to my Mercury in the 10th house, where my ex-husband’s Venus is. Mercury in the 10th house can connect to career, skills, communication, work, reputation, and the way a person is seen in the world. His Venus connecting with my Mercury there makes me reflect on how much my career success, intelligence, and ability to contribute may have been tied to love, attraction, stability, and the financial hopes we had for our marriage.

For him, love may have been connected to the promise of success, security, and shared financial growth. When I became sick and had to leave my job, the dream we thought we were building began to fall apart. Illness, financial stress, grief, and years of trying changed everything.

Taurus is connected to love, loyalty, comfort, stability, beauty, money, values, and the things we hope will last. Under this New Moon, I found myself remembering the dream of growing old together, walking hand in hand on the beach, moving to Anna Maria near the water, and believing that love would carry us through every season of life.

Sometimes love is real, and still life changes everything. This song holds the tenderness of what was, the sadness of what was lost, and the quiet hope that love can still exist, even after heartbreak.

The HD Astro Membership helps you understand moments like this through Human Design and Astrology. Inside the membership, you can learn how the planets, signs, houses, Human Design Gates, Gene Keys, lines, and transits connect to your personal experiences, emotions, relationships, memories, patterns, and life lessons.

If you want to understand your own chart, follow the current transits, and see how astrology and Human Design can bring deeper meaning to what you are moving through, you can explore the HD Astro Membership here:

https://healthmanifested.com/hd-astro-course-options/

This is a song for anyone who has ever remembered a love that changed their life, a vow they still carry, or a dream that never became what they hoped.

records.title: I want a home
records.description:
This song was inspired during a moment that brought everything back to the surface.

As Mars moved over my Moon and Venus, it activated the same place in my life where I had previously lost my home and almost all of my possessions during my divorce. That time forced me to live out of my car and completely start over.

For the past 682 days, I have been moving from place to place. Pet sitting, staying with friends, and doing whatever I can to keep going. I am grateful for the support I have received, but there is still a deep longing for something that is truly my own.

When this energy was activated again, it didn’t just pass quietly. It brought back the feeling of instability, the memory of losing everything, and the reality that I still don’t have a place to call home.

There is something deeply emotional about not having a stable place to land. Not knowing where you will be next. Not having a space where your body can fully relax.

That is where this song comes from.

I want a home.
Not just somewhere to stay.
A place that is mine.
A place that is stable.
A place where I can feel safe and at peace.

Even when it feels like it has gone on for too long, I am still holding onto the belief that this will change.

If you are going through a time where life feels uncertain or unstable, you are not alone.

Explore more music, astrology, and Human Design:
https://healthmanifested.com/

records.title: Both Sides of the Coin
records.description:
This song is part of my Astrology in Real Life series where I share real experiences through the lens of astrology and personal reflection.

Recently we experienced a Pisces Full Moon eclipse that landed on my natal Venus in the 8th house. Venus represents love, relationships, and values, while the 8th house is connected to shared resources, financial entanglements, and the deep emotional bonds created when two lives become intertwined.

Eclipses often reveal truths that take years to fully understand. When this Pisces eclipse happened, it brought a wave of emotional clarity about my past relationship and divorce.

During my divorce, my former husband and I were in mediation during a Libra New Moon eclipse. Libra is the sign of fairness, balance, and partnership. Libra energy asks us to consider both sides of a situation and try to reach an agreement that feels just.

Looking back now, I realize this song reflects that Libra lesson. It is about recognizing that something can feel unfair to both people at the same time.

I felt trapped and unsafe without financial independence. He felt like he was carrying the responsibility of supporting everything and believed he was doing what was fair. We were both trying, but our needs and perspectives were different.

Libra reminds us that relationships are complex. Two people can love each other and still struggle to create balance.

The recent Pisces eclipse on my Venus helped me see the deeper emotional layer of that experience. Instead of only remembering the pain, I can now see both sides of the story with more compassion.

This song is about that realization and the moment when understanding finally replaces resentment.

records.title: The Light Inside the Knowing
records.description:
This song was inspired by a real experience during a time when I was searching for answers about my life. I went to Cassadaga, a spiritual town known for intuitive readings, hoping to understand what I was going through and what might lie ahead.

It also feels fitting to share this story during Pisces season. Pisces is known as one of the most intuitive and psychic signs in astrology. This time of year often heightens intuition, dreams, spiritual awareness, and the sense that there is something more unfolding behind the scenes of life.

During that time I began learning astrology and paying attention to timing in a deeper way. The readings I received spoke about changes in my life, my marriage, my family, and the possibility that my work and voice would grow in ways I could not yet see. Some of what I heard was beautiful. Some of it was very hard to carry.

What stayed with me the most was the feeling of living with the knowledge that life might change. Instead of taking moments for granted, I tried to appreciate every second with the people I loved.

There were also powerful signs that reminded me that life is bigger than what we can see. One reader shared a message from my grandfather who I used to collect coins with. He said that every time I see a feather it is like a coin from him reminding me he is still near.

Another moment that stayed with me was being invited to a home high in the Appalachian mountains, literally in the clouds. It felt like seeing a glimpse of a possible future life.

This song reflects the strange beauty and weight of knowing that life moves in cycles. Astrology often shows us patterns and timing, but living through those moments is where the real meaning unfolds.

Sometimes astrology is not just about charts or transits. Sometimes it shows up through intuition, signs, timing, and the way life quietly unfolds around us.

With the Sun, Mercury, Mars, and the North Node all moving through Pisces, emotions can rise like waves from the past. Pisces energy often brings reflection, memories, and a deeper connection to the dreams people once believed in.

This song was written during a time of remembering the life that once felt magical. The beach days, the laughter, the family gatherings, the travel, and the feeling of being loved and part of something meaningful. It is about looking back at those moments and honoring the dream that once lived so strongly in the heart.

Pisces can also bring awareness of loss. It can stir memories of relationships that ended, the pain of abandonment, and the quiet question of whether the love people believed in was real or only something imagined. When so many planets move through Pisces at once, it can feel like the heart is revisiting old memories and unfinished emotions.

Yet Pisces is also connected to hope, imagination, and the ability to believe in something beautiful again. Even when a dream life changes or disappears, the heart that dreamed it still exists.

This song reflects the space between grief and hope. Remembering the good times, honoring the love that was once felt, and still believing that somewhere ahead there is a new chapter waiting. A life that brings the love, happiness, connection, and sense of belonging that was once experienced before everything changed.

If you enjoy following the astrology behind these emotional waves, the HD Astro Membership shares deeper guidance on the planetary transits happening right now. records.title: What Could’ve Been
records.description:
It seems like in America, it is the land of opportunity but people have to work very hard to maintain their lifestyle and keep up with the expenses that are required to run our lives.

This song is for the dreamers who clock in every day but still carry big ideas in their back pocket. It is for the people who have notebooks full of plans, business ideas, creative sparks, and quiet visions of a different life. The only thing standing in the way is time, energy, and the courage to take the risk.

“What Could’ve Been” was created during the Full Moon Eclipse in Virgo, and the timing could not have been more real.

My car died during this eclipse. Completely. In the middle of trying to hold everything together, I was facing the possibility of having to shut my website down because I needed a car and did not know how I could afford both. The website costs money to run. A car costs money. Survival costs money.

For the past two years, I have chosen to sacrifice stability in order to keep believing in this dream. I have been pet sitting in exchange for a place to live, without consistent income, trying to keep Health Manifested alive. Trying to keep creating. Trying to trust that the work would eventually support me.

During this same eclipse, while I was having serious conversations about whether I would have to close everything down, my ex-husband stepped in to help me find a new car. While helping me through that process, he also learned how I create these songs and helped bring this one to life. He saw firsthand the structure, intention, and meaning behind turning astrology and real life into music.

The Full Moon Eclipse in Virgo is about the details of life. The bills. The systems. The routines. The practical reality that does not go away just because you have a dream. Virgo energy asks us to refine, adjust, and make difficult decisions.

This song carries that exact energy.

The exhaustion of trying to survive.
The weight of responsibility.
The fear of letting go.
And the quiet decision to try anyway.

I have sacrificed comfort. I have sacrificed certainty. I have sacrificed stability. Not because it is glamorous, but because I did not want to look back one day and wonder what could have been if I had just kept going a little longer.

If you are in a season where you are choosing your dream over comfort, this song is for you.

You will never know what could have been if you never try.

https://healthmanifested.com/hd-astro-course-options/

And if you want weekly insights about the Gates, degrees, eclipses, and transits delivered to you:

Thank you for listening and being part of this journey.

records.title: Retrograde Tide Mercury in Pisces
records.description:
This song came from a very real day.

Mercury retrograde in Pisces has a way of blurring time, misaligning plans, and bringing hidden stress to the surface. For me, this retrograde is moving through my 8th house, one of the money houses. The 8th house rules shared resources, debt, and unexpected financial obligations. And yesterday, that symbolism felt very literal.

On the way to St. Pete, my car started shaking. What I thought was a simple battery issue turned out to be something else. Hours passed waiting on a machanic who never arrived. An important appointment slipped through the wrong time. And what could have been a manageable repair turned into a much larger expense.

Pisces dissolves structure. Retrograde slows things down. The 8th house exposes financial pressure and the places where we feel vulnerable.

I write these songs from lived experience. This is not abstract astrology. It is real life moving through real transits.

If this resonates with you, if you have ever felt a retrograde show up through timing issues, money stress, or unexpected costs, thank you for listening and sharing this space.

And if you feel called to support the music and the ongoing creation of these songs, Super Thanks or the membership are always deeply appreciated. It truly helps during moments when expenses arrive unexpectedly.

records.title: I Found My Way Through LeoAquarius Eclipses
records.description:
I turned my story into a song.

I got married in 2009 during the Leo and Aquarius eclipse cycle. Leo rules the heart, identity, and the courage to love boldly. Aquarius rules the future, freedom, and the path that calls you beyond tradition. That eclipse season marked the beginning of a chapter where I thought love and destiny were the same thing.

Eclipses do not just create events. They mark turning points.

Now in 2026, the Leo and Aquarius eclipses return. The same axis. The same themes. But I am not the same person.

Between those cycles there was illness in 2015. The creation of my website in 2017 as a hope for a different future. Family fractures. Traveling with love in 2020. Divorce and losing my home in 2024. Becoming a traveling pet sitter in 2025 and continuing to build what I believe in, no matter where I sleep.

Leo asks: Who am I now?
Aquarius asks: Where am I going?

Astrology in real life is not abstract. It is lived through vows, hospitals, road trips, loss, rebuilding, and choosing to create again.

This song is about watching a 18 year eclipse cycle complete itself. About understanding that endings are not punishment. They are redirection.

records.title: An explanation of my creative process and educational framework
records.description:
This video explains how the content on this channel is created, why it exists, and how it is meant to be used.

Health Manifested is an educational channel that translates astrology, Human Design, and related symbolic systems into sound and music to support learning, reflection, and personal study. Each video corresponds to a specific concept such as a Human Design Gate, an astrological transit, a degree, or a symbolic theme that is taught inside my original courses and written material.

The songs on this channel are created using AI as a creative and production tool, similar to how recording software or digital instruments are used. The curriculum, meanings, structure, and prompts are designed by me. I decide what each song represents and how it fits into the educational framework. AI assists with expressing these teachings through sound, but it does not choose the topics or structure.

This channel functions as a companion library to my courses and weekly educational work. Each week, I write original emails explaining current astrology and Human Design transits and select specific songs from this channel that correspond to those themes. The songs are used as learning tools alongside written interpretation and timing rather than as standalone content.

Some playlists on this channel are curated as part of a project called Lightworkers Web, which highlights professionals and educators who share their expertise through structured educational content. For example, certain playlists were created in collaboration with practitioners featured on my website to support their teaching work. These playlists exist for clear educational reasons and are created intentionally rather than generated at random.

This video is provided to explain authorship, creative process, and educational intent so viewers understand how to approach this content intentionally.

records.title: Love Didn’t Pay the Bills
records.description:
This song is about the moment love was labeled impractical.

It begins with a memory of being told that love does not pay the bills, and how that message follows a person through life. For people who lead with care, connection, and devotion, survival often becomes tied to proving usefulness instead of being loved for who they are.

This song reflects on Saturn moving over the Moon and Venus, a time when stability, home, relationships, and belonging can be stripped away. It explores the grief of losing a marriage, losing possessions, losing people, and questioning whether love would have been enough if money had been there instead.

Many people quietly wonder if they would still be loved if they could provide more. This song gives voice to that question without answering it, because sometimes the asking itself is the truth.

Love may not pay the bills, but that does not make love wrong.

records.title: The religion of spiritualism explained  science, philosophy, and spiritual truth
records.description:
Spiritualism is a science, a philosophy, and a religion based on direct experience, personal responsibility, and continued spiritual growth. In this class, Reverend Stephen G. Adkins explains the Religion of Spiritualism and how it differs from traditional belief systems. Spiritualism does not impose a fixed idea of God, does not seek conversion, and does not rely on savior based theology. Instead, it encourages people to develop a direct, personal relationship with God through experience, awareness, and lived truth.

This presentation explores core Spiritualist principles, including continued life after physical death, the survival of personality, communication with loved ones in Spirit through Mediumship, energetic healing as a demonstrated spiritual truth, the role of Natural Law, and the importance of personal responsibility in spiritual development. Spiritualism teaches that truth exists in all religions and that spiritual growth continues through conscious choice and awareness.

You can download the free class document here to read or reflect on the material at your own pace:
https://healthmanifested.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Rev-Steve-Adkins-Religion-of-Spiritualism.pdf

If this class resonated with you and you feel drawn to deepen your understanding of Mediumship and energetic healing, explore Mediumship and the Modern Mind, a membership designed to support people developing Mediumship, intuitive awareness, and energetic healing in a grounded and experiential way:
https://healthmanifested.com/mediumship-and-the-modern-mind-course-options/

To learn more about Reverend Stephen G. Adkins, his work, and Cassadaga Spiritualist Camp, visit:
https://www.cassadaga.cc/

You can also view Steve’s Lightworkers profile, sessions, and offerings here:
https://healthmanifested.com/members/healersteve36/

If you are a spiritual based or healing professional and would like to increase your visibility and build authority in the online space, the Lightworkers Web offers a supportive professional network to help you share your work and connect with others:
https://healthmanifested.com/become-a-lightworker

records.title: The River That Changed My Life
records.description:
Sometimes there are places in nature that hold our memories. Places where we sat in pain, prayed for change, and quietly rebuilt our strength. This river was one of those places.

It reminds us that healing is not always loud. Sometimes it looks like showing up for ourselves in silence. It looks like sitting with our feelings, asking for guidance, and choosing to believe that life can become better.

This spot represents growth after heartbreak, rebuilding after loss, and trusting the process even when nothing makes sense. It holds the energy of prayer, reflection, grief, and deep transformation.

I returned here today to honor how far I have come and to let myself feel everything. Life can be unfair and painful, but even in the hardest moments, there are sacred places that help us remember our strength.

If you are in a season of change or loss, I hope this video reminds you of three things:

You are allowed to pause and breathe.

You are allowed to feel everything.

You are becoming stronger in ways you cannot yet see.

Growth often starts in the quiet moments when we sit with our truth. This river holds mine. May it gently remind you of yours.

records.title: Both Love and Pain: Full Moon Eclipse in Pisces conjunct natal Venus
records.description:
This song Both Love and Pain was written from the depth of my heart during the Full Moon Eclipse in Pisces conjunct my Venus. The eclipse brought so much to the surface, memories, heartbreak, and the love I still carry alongside the pain of loss. This song is my way of expressing the emotions that feel too big to hold inside, a reflection of both the beauty and sorrow that Venus can reveal when touched by the Moon in Pisces.

I hope these words resonate with anyone who has ever loved so deeply that the absence of that love feels just as alive as its presence.

If you feel connected to this song and my work, I invite you to explore the HD Astro Membership where I share more about Human Design, Astrology, and how these transits shape our lives:
👉 https://healthmanifested.com/hd-astro-course-options

records.title: Anna Maria My Happy Place
records.description:
Lyrics:
Anna Maria (My Happy Place)

Verse 1
I’ve been walking these shores since I was a child
Where my grandmother lived, where the sunsets smiled
Every weekend we came, with the waves in our hands
Anna Maria held me like the softest sand

Verse 2
With the one I once married, we floated the tide
Hand in hand at the pier, love burning inside
But the Rod N Reel washed away in the storm
Like the love that I prayed would keep me warm

Chorus
Anna Maria, you’re my happy place
Through the tears and the laughter, I see your face
The pier may be gone, but the memory stays
I’m rebuilding my life in your ocean waves

Verse 3
I met my first love where the pelicans fly
Held another’s hand there, and tried not to cry
The whispers of fate were too heavy to bear
But the joy of this island is always still there

Verse 4
I swam with my friends in the shimmering blue
Some drifted away, like the tides often do
The pier may return, though the future’s unclear
I hold onto the hope I’ll still find it here

Chorus
Anna Maria, you’re my happy place
Through the tears and the laughter, I see your face
The pier may be gone, but the memory stays
I’m rebuilding my life in your ocean waves

Bridge
I wanted my family to love me true
But I couldn’t be the daughter they wanted me to
Divorced hearts and broken ties
Still I find peace in your gulf skies

Final Chorus
Anna Maria, you’re my sacred ground
Through the echoes of love, I hear your sound
The pier may return, but I won’t erase
I’ll rebuild my life in your sweet embrace

Anna Maria Island has always been my happy place. I have been going there since I was a child, spending weekends with my grandmother, later sharing the beaches, sunsets, and pier with the people I loved most. This song reflects the memories I hold there, filled with both joy and sadness, and the hope to rebuild a life filled with love and beauty.

The Rod N Reel Pier holds a special place in my heart. It was where I met my first boyfriend, years with my ex-husband and later, at the end of our marriage, I sat there hand in hand with him, soaking up every moment knowing the divorce was approaching. Even though the pier was swept away in hurricane Milton, I carry hope that it will be rebuilt, just as I carry hope for myself.

00:00 opening tones to help you unwind and arrive

records.title: You Knew What You Were Doing
records.description:
This song came through during one of the most difficult and transformative times in my life. 

As Saturn moves through Pisces in my 8th house where my natal Moon and Venus are, I’ve been faced with deep emotional pain, financial strain, and the heavy task of starting over. This experience has tested me in ways I never imagined, and the truth is, I’m still moving through it.

"You Knew What You Were Doing" is not about blame. It’s about speaking the truth of what it feels like to be left behind, to feel unseen, undervalued, unappreciated and to survive in silence. The pain is real, the grief is real, and so is the strength it takes to keep going.

This part of my journey continues until Saturn moves into Aries on February 13, 2026. Until then, I’m doing what I can to heal, create, and give voice to what was never acknowledged.

For anyone who has felt abandoned or stripped of everything and everyone they loved, this song is for you. You are not alone.
